시편-62-1.title: 시편 62장 1절 역사문법적 주해
시편-62-1.exegesis: 8. Thus for new blessings will new vows of praise ever be paid.
시편-62-1.theologicalNote: 8. Thus for new blessings will new vows of praise ever be paid.

시편-62-2.title: 시편 62장 2절 역사문법적 주해
시편-62-2.exegesis: PSALM 62 Psa 62:1-12 . To Jeduthun--(See on Psa 39:1 , title). The general tone of this Psalm is expressive of confidence in God. Occasion is taken to remind the wicked of their sin, their ruin, and their meanness. 1. waiteth-- literally, "is silent," trusts submissively and confidently as a servant.
시편-62-2.theologicalNote: PSALM 62 Psa 62:1-12 . To Jeduthun--(See on Psa 39:1 , title). The general tone of this Psalm is expressive of confidence in God. 시편-62-3.title: 시편 62장 3절 역사문법적 주해
시편-62-3.exegesis: 2. The titles applied to God often occur ( Psa 9:9 ; 18:2 ). be greatly moved-- ( Psa 10:6 ). No injury shall be permanent, though devised by enemies.
시편-62-3.theologicalNote: 2. The titles applied to God often occur ( Psa 9:9 ; 18:2 ). be greatly moved-- ( Psa 10:6 ). No injury shall be permanent, though devised by enemies.

시편-62-4.title: 시편 62장 4절 역사문법적 주해
시편-62-4.exegesis: 3. Their destruction will come; as a tottering wall they already are feeble and failing. bowing wall shall ye be-- better supply "are." Some propose to apply these phrases to describe the condition of "a man"--that is, the pious suffer: thus, "Will ye slay him," &c.; but the other is a good sense.
시편-62-4.theologicalNote: 3. Their destruction will come; as a tottering wall they already are feeble and failing. bowing wall shall ye be-- better supply "are." 시편-62-5.title: 시편 62장 5절 역사문법적 주해
시편-62-5.exegesis: 4. his excellency-- or, elevation to which God had raised him ( Psa 4:2 ). This they try to do by lies and duplicity ( Psa 5:9 ).
시편-62-5.theologicalNote: 4. his excellency-- or, elevation to which God had raised him ( Psa 4:2 ). This they try to do by lies and duplicity ( Psa 5:9 ).

시편-62-8.title: 시편 62장 8절 역사문법적 주해
시편-62-8.exegesis: 7. rock of my strength-- or strongest support ( Psa 7:10 ; 61:3 ).
시편-62-8.theologicalNote: 7. rock of my strength-- or strongest support ( Psa 7:10 ; 61:3 ).

시편-62-9.title: 시편 62장 9절 역사문법적 주해
시편-62-9.exegesis: 8. pour out your heart-- give full expression to feeling ( 1Sa 1:15 ; Job 30:16 ; Psa 42:4 ). ye people-- God's people.
시편-62-9.theologicalNote: 8. pour out your heart-- give full expression to feeling ( 1Sa 1:15 ; Job 30:16 ; Psa 42:4 ). ye people-- God's people.

시편-62-10.title: 시편 62장 10절 역사문법적 주해
시편-62-10.exegesis: 9. No kind of men are reliable, compared with God ( Is 2:22 ; Jr 17:5 ). altogether-- alike, one as the other ( Psa 34:3 ).
시편-62-10.theologicalNote: 9. No kind of men are reliable, compared with God ( Is 2:22 ; Jr 17:5 ). altogether-- alike, one as the other ( Psa 34:3 ).

시편-62-11.title: 시편 62장 11절 역사문법적 주해
시편-62-11.exegesis: 10. Not only are oppression and robbery, which are wicked means of wealth, no grounds of boasting; but even wealth, increasing lawfully, ought not to engross the heart.
시편-62-11.theologicalNote: 10. Not only are oppression and robbery, which are wicked means of wealth, no grounds of boasting; but even wealth, increasing lawfully, ought not to engross the heart.

시편-62-12.title: 시편 62장 12절 역사문법적 주해
시편-62-12.exegesis: 11. once; twice-- (as in Job 33:14 ; 40:5 ), are used to give emphasis to the sentiment. God's power is tempered by His mercy, which it also sustains.
시편-62-12.theologicalNote: 11. once; twice-- (as in Job 33:14 ; 40:5 ), are used to give emphasis to the sentiment. God's power is tempered by His mercy, which it also sustains.
